blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Ministry of Cooperation 5th Foundation Day: Plans Cooperative Life Insurance & 'Sahakar Taxi'. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Announces utility aggregator cooperative for ride-hailing and converts 50,000 PACS into e-PACS.
Cooperative Life Insurance: Plans dedicated cooperative life insurer building on IFFCO-Tokio general insurance model.
Sahakar Taxi Aggregator: Establishes utility aggregator cooperative on lines of 'Bharat Taxi' (0.63M drivers, 3.58M registered users).
Infrastructure & Seeds: Transferred 135 godowns (75,000 tonnes capacity) and signed BBSSL-ICAR MoU for certified seed tissue culture.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
